meta.name: Drop Out
meta.description: A young man battles between personal dreams and society's demands, navigating the weight of academic stress, career confusion, and inner turmoil that defines his generation's struggle for meaning.
meta.slogan: When a young dreamer is forced to drop out of college, he faces a defining choice-accept society's labels or rewrite his own destiny. In his journey, he dares to challenge the very definition of intelligence and success.
